concept.title: Migration Prerequisites
concept.shortdesc: Before submitting a document to the metR HTML to DITA converter, verify the following prerequisites:

conbody.p: Before submitting a document to the metR HTML to DITA converter, verify the following prerequisites:

ol.li: The HTML files are complete and available in the expected folder structure.
The root folder contains the main index, if available, along with the HTML files.
Each HTML file has a clear heading hierarchy.
Heading levels are not used only for visual styling.
Images are available in the package and referenced correctly.
Internal and external links are valid.
Tables use real HTML table markup and are not simulated with spaces, tabs, or images.

conbody.note: Before conversion, review the HTML in a browser and in source view. Confirm that the visible content and the HTML structure match.
